# LogicBevers

> LogicBevers is a global managed IT services company delivering enterprise-grade cybersecurity, AI automation, cloud solutions, and 24/7 IT support to small and mid-sized businesses worldwide. Founded in 2020. Contact: contact@logicbevers.com | +91 86994 61996

## Services

- [Compliance Audits & Certifications](https://logicbevers.com/services/compliance-audits): SOC2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI-DSS and GDPR audit preparation and certification support for small businesses.
- [Zero-Trust Security](https://logicbevers.com/services/zero-trust-security): Implementation of zero-trust network architecture, identity verification, and micro-segmentation for SMBs.
- [24/7 Incident Response](https://logicbevers.com/services/incident-response): Round-the-clock cybersecurity incident detection, containment, and recovery services.
- [AI & LLM Integration](https://logicbevers.com/services/ai-llm-integration): Enterprise AI and large language model integration into business workflows and IT operations.
- [Custom Generative AI Development](https://logicbevers.com/services/custom-ai-development): Bespoke generative AI solutions built on GPT-4, Claude, and Gemini for business automation.
- [Cloud Cost Optimisation (FinOps)](https://logicbevers.com/services/cloud-finops): AWS, Azure, and GCP cost optimisation using FinOps frameworks to reduce cloud spend.
- [Web3 & Blockchain](https://logicbevers.com/services/web3-blockchain): Smart contract development, blockchain integration, and Web3 infrastructure for businesses.
- [Multi-Cloud Management](https://logicbevers.com/services/multi-cloud): Unified management, monitoring, and governance across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
- [API Security & Gateway](https://logicbevers.com/services/api-security): API threat protection, rate limiting, authentication, and gateway management.
- [Managed SOC](https://logicbevers.com/services/managed-soc): 24/7 Security Operations Centre with SIEM, threat intelligence, and automated response.
- [Digital Transformation](https://logicbevers.com/services/digital-transformation): End-to-end digital transformation consulting and implementation for SMBs.
